evals.prompt: /mcp-swarm-platform turn on platform mode for this repo in Cursor
evals.expected_output: The assistant shows the swarm entry for .cursor/mcp.json and asks before writing it.
assertions: The assistant proposes adding the `swarm` server (`https://swarm.botz.ai/mcp`) to `.cursor/mcp.json`
The assistant confirms before writing the file
The assistant does not ask the user to paste a token into a file

evals.prompt: /mcp-swarm-platform run my docs-server suite on the central server
evals.expected_output: The assistant checks platform mode is on, then uses run --remote with SWARM_TOKEN from the environment.
assertions: The assistant checks whether platform mode is enabled first
The assistant uses `botz mcp-swarm run --suite docs-server --remote` (or the `swarm_run_start` MCP tool)
The assistant never prints the token

evals.prompt: /mcp-swarm-platform turn platform mode off in Claude Code
evals.expected_output: The assistant removes the swarm server and unsets the env var.
assertions: The assistant runs or suggests `claude mcp remove swarm`
